summary: Blue Bird Corporation filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 reporting that on September 30, 2026 it entered into a Second Amendment to its November 17, 2023 Credit Agreement with Bank of Montreal as administrative agent and other lenders. The amendment extends maturity from November 17, 2028 to September 30, 2031, raises total Senior Secured Credit Facilities to $600 million from $250 million, lifts the revolver commitment to $300 million from $150 million, and converts the $100 million Term Loan A to a $300 million delayed draw term loan with $214 million available and $86 million transferred. Pricing improves to SOFR plus 1.25%-2.25% from SOFR plus 1.75%-3.25%. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation.
